# Security Policy

## Supported scope

Security reports may concern the active ProofShift preview/evaluator codebase.
There is no production-hosted ProofShift service.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not post vulnerability details, exploit steps, credentials, or sensitive
customer data in public issues or pull requests.

GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled for this repository. Use
GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature to submit vulnerability
details. Do not post reports publicly; no security email address is published.

## Data and secrets

Never submit real customer, employer, government, or production data.
Repository fixtures must be deterministic synthetic data. Do not commit
credentials, tokens, connection strings, PII, PHI, confidential schemas, or
proprietary employer/client implementation details.
